what_it_is: Single-lumen microcatheter designed for introduction over a steerable guidewire into vasculature during neurovascular procedures. Nitinol braid technology with progressive picks-per-inch. Graduated zones and transition points for balance between pushability and softness. DMSO compatible for liquid embolic delivery.
indications: Introduction of interventional devices and infusion of diagnostic or therapeutic agents during neurovascular procedures. DMSO-compatible for Onyx liquid embolic delivery.
compatible_with: Onyx Liquid Embolic System (DMSO compatible), Pipeline Flex, Solitaire X, X-Pedion hydrophilic guidewire
use_notes: Nitinol braid provides kink resistance and minimal ovalization for reliable device delivery. Echelon 10 has low profile 1.7F distal OD for accessing small vessels.
